data.name: Workflow description
data.value: A global invoice (CFDI de público en general) consolidates all public sales for a period into a single SAT-stamped document. Stamp errors do not lock the sales — they remain available for a new attempt.

data.name: Rounding note intro
data.value: The CFDI total may differ by a few cents from the sum of individual receipts. The SAT requires Total = SubTotal − Discount + VAT (rule CFDI40119); VAT is recalculated from the aggregated base, not summed from already-rounded individual taxes.

data.name: Example label
data.value: Example — two sales of $7.00 at 16% VAT

data.name: Rounding conclusion
data.value: The $0.01 difference is a SAT-recognised rounding artefact and does not represent a cash discrepancy.
